en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural scene with a stone well or spring structure in the foreground identified as Idris baba's well. A person stands drawing water with buckets. A cobblestone road curves past simple houses and fences, with a grassy hill and small column-like roadside shrine bearing a cross on the left. Trees and low hills are in the background under a cloudy sky. The reverse side contains handwritten Hungarian text, a Hungarian postage stamp, and typical postcard address lines.
